amendment.build_boundary: Updated Objective-C++ probe object passed the configured -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror compile and linked against existing prebuilt MetalRobo libraries. The full CMake target remains blocked by unrelated NeuronCulture.metal -Wunused-parameter under -Werror.
amendment.prior_failure: The v3 renderer accepted the ABI2 diagnostic bone payload but failed during the Metal pose pass with an empty diagnostic message before any frame was written.
amendment.purpose: The local probe now includes the Metal host status, dispatch/publication flags, environment counts, first GPU status, device and detail text in that failure message. This diagnostic-only code change does not change pose, model, payload or rendering behavior.

analysis: Record detailed native host/GPU diagnostics and, if the pose/render pass succeeds, inspect the retained right-side frame against the source geometry receipt. This single static view is not a skin rendering, high-flex test, population estimate, clinical validation or loaded mechanics result.
device: Record the actual Metal device and host/GPU failure fields reported by the updated local probe.

experimental_units_and_conditions.arms: one right-side bone-only diagnostic view of the source patella, femur and tibia; no skin shell or ABI5 payload
experimental_units_and_conditions.camera: side view, camera index 2, 512 px; focus patella source body using installed --focus-body-index default framing distance
experimental_units_and_conditions.pose: literal source qpos0, no trajectory or force input
experimental_units_and_conditions.retries: none; preserve any failure as inconclusive

model_and_mechanism.renderer_abi_limit: This local renderer accepts ABI 4 and does not accept the ABI 5 full-weight payload. The ABI 4 input is an explicit top-four diagnostic projection, not the ABI 5 candidate.

prediction_and_refutation.native_visibility: A successful right bone-only frame has nonzero rendered source surfaces for the registered patella, femur and tibia.
prediction_and_refutation.refutation: Native pose/render failure, missing requested source surface, or right source anteriority below 0.025 m. Any renderer or device failure is inconclusive.
prediction_and_refutation.source_metric: Right patella minimum literal-qpos0 vertex anteriority to pinned source knee-anchor plane is at least 0.025 m.

question: Does the current equality-neutral source pose place each BodyParts3D patella anterior to the source knee-anchor plane, and does the native ABI4 diagnostic shell still present a coherent outer knee contour around it?
stopping_rule: Run exactly this one capture once. Stop on completion or failure; no retries, no camera adjustment, and no automatic left or skin-shell arm.
